dict.string: Sextant transcribes your side of calls on this Mac. Audio never leaves the device or touches the disk.
Sextant transcribes the other side of calls from the call app only. Audio never leaves the device or touches the disk.
Sextant reads the address of the browser tab you are looking at, so it can group your work.
Sextant reads your last 90 days of calendar events to draw your first workflow map.
Sextant reads your reminders to find promises you keep pushing.
